qualification.education_qualification: M.Sc. in Botany/ Zoology/ Forestry/ Wildlife/ Soil Sciences with I Division.
qualification.details: Working Plan Associate: M.Sc. in Botany/ Zoology/ Forestry/ Wildlife/ Soil Sciences from a recognized University with I Division (at least 60% Marks). Desirable Experience: Good knowledge and skills in computer Application (MS-Excel, MS-Word, MS-Power Point etc). Field work experience in forestry research with knowledge and experience in identification of Tree, shrubs and herbs in the forest and measurement of inventory parameters of forest vegetation. Knowledge of GIS specially handling of GPS devices and basic knowledge on Geospatial Technologies. Physically fit for extensive travel and trek in the mountainous/ plain region. Research Articles published in a recognized journal. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience of Forestry/ Wildlife related research and surveys and in Biodiversity related issues.

salary_details.details: Emolument: Rs. 25000/ - per month (fixed) plus travelling allowance as per Government norms.

selection_process: Applications received will be scrutinized and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview (either in person or online) before the selection committee. No TA/ DA will be paid for attending the interview in person. The decision of the committee will be final and binding. The committee reserves the right to withdraw/ cancel the candidature of one or all selection applications without assigning any reason.
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Haldwani Forest Division Working Plan Associate Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.forest.uk.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Working Plan Associate post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Working Plan Associate position is 05 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the office by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Wildlife, or Soil Sciences with a First Division (at least 60% Marks) from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Working Plan Associate role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years as of 01 January 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Women candidates as per state rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Working Plan Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month, along with travelling allowance as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. You need to download the application form, fill it, and send it along with self-attested documents via registered/speed post or email to the specified address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Working Plan Associate post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, which may be conducted in person or online. The selection committee's decision will be final.

faq.question: Q8. Is prior experience required for this role?
faq.answer: While not strictly mandatory, experience in forestry research, computer applications, GIS, and biodiversity issues is desirable and may be given preference.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Haldwani Forest Division, which is www.forest.uk.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be provided for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, TA/DA will not be provided for attending the interview in person. Candidates are responsible for their own travel expenses.
